title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Umrah on behalf of a living person 6424 views Q. Can I take my 12 year old daughter for Haj with intention of performing fardh Hajj from her? 1995 views Q. Dear Mufti Sahab. I have two qustions please issue me your fatwa,by fazal of Allha, I am going for haj this year. my cousin brother and I are not speaking to each other for more then 5 years because of some dispute, i want to apoligise but he is not willing,my brothers are telling me that my haj will not complete if i will not speak.second qustion is in our town every haji before leaving for haj they will garleds with flowers ( phowloon ka har) this is right or wrong. 2524 views Q. Delay the monthly period for purpose of Umrah 6118 views Q. Performing Umrah with Mehram/husband. 6380 views Q. If one is in the state of Ihraam, can one touch the Ka'bah or go to the Multazam as it is fragranced? 8008 views Q. How far it is justifiable in the eyes of Shariah to allow a non-Muslim politician in the Mehrab area of a Masjid (beside the Imam right after the Namaz 1639 views Q. My age is 44 yesrs & I have not done my Haj so far but,intended to do in the near future with wife.I want to do Haj-e-badal for my late grand father who died without doing his own Haj. I have been under debt,the loan has been taken from Individuals as well as Bank to fulfill various needs including house constuction.My wife is pregnent & she can't go for Haj this year.Two daughters are very small-6 & 3 yrs old respectively. The expense of late grand father's Haj-e-badal has to be born by my parents,who are also going for their Haj this year. Now my question is :- Taking into above facts & circumstances,Can I do the Haj-e-badal for my late grand father without doing my own Haj? 1823 views Q. My question is keeping qarza we can do urmrha or not? 7006 views Q. I want to ask a question about Halaque ( shaving hair of head) is it necessary for a Man who is doing umrah? is it permissible for a man to shorten his hair after umrah. if a man shorten his hair not shaved, has he completed umrah or uncompleted or is there any kind of charity etc? 9674 views Q. I reside in Riyadh and would like to go for umra. We have 4 daughters and we are trying to schedule umra accordingly but have difficulty doing so. Can those of us who are menstruating stay at the hotel in Makkah while the rest of the family performs umra? 1700 views Q. Dear Mufti Sahab. I am going haj this year.We are currently export goods.Now we want to export in Saudi araibia.Can we do business in first Haj ?If not then can we give our business card to there importer for future business? 1600 views Q. I am working in Jubail, K.S.A. Last year I performed Haj along with the Dawah Center of Jubail with Tashree (Permission to Perform Haj from Saudi Government. I had a small doubt i.e. as we are performing Haje-E-Tamattu. We performed Umrah and then they alloted accomodation in Muzadalifa and they are calling as extension mena. during Haj We have to stay in Mena and perform Salah in mena but we are in muzdalifa, so it is permissible to stay in extension mena and offer salah. Please advise what to do. 1581 views Q. As salam alaikum, Respected ulama of deoband. My question is regarding umrah. I stay in KSA and i have commit a mistake during umrah i have to give (dum). until now i have not given dum is there any other option insted of dum. And what is the time to give the dum. please explain in detail in the light of quran and hadith. 3965 views Q. Can one send his father on a nafli hajj before himself doing an obligatory hajj? 1919 views
